source_policy: Primary standards, research, official documentation, first-party engineering publications, and first-party retrospectives. Vendor and employer evidence is labeled; access does not imply endorsement; volatile implementation claims require edition-visible versions and limitations.

url_health.method: HTTP GET with redirects and partial-body cancellation
url_health.note: Restricted sources returned 403 to automated access but were discoverable through current search/index evidence or DOI resolution. No registered URL returned 404 or 5xx after corrections.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile

sources.limitations: Benchmark-specific results and 2020 architecture; mechanism illustrates tradeoffs rather than a prescribed stack.

sources.limitations: Systems benchmark evidence; similarity search alone does not establish semantic relevance or permission.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

sources.limitations: First-party report using marketplace-specific signals; engagement is not universal user value.

sources.title: Model Evaluation: Quantifying the Quality of Predictions
sources.limitations: Library documentation explains metrics and APIs; it cannot choose product criteria, consequences, or thresholds.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks

sources.limitations: Specific selective-classification formulation; application escalation and human authority require separate design.
